snippet.title: Tyrants Rafting - Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Tyrants Rafting Steam Demo Trailer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200060/Tyrants_Rafting/


You and your friend play as dictators trying to escape through post war Syria before the timer runs out.

The catch?

You both control the same boat.

One player controls the left.
The other controls the right.

- Crazy traps
- ILL U MAMI SONG
- Pickup truck with guns
- Golden speedboat
- Loud techno,

------

The game is hard
It's fast paced.
It's not relaxing.
And it's not easy.

The Steam demo is live right now.

There will be many more levels, more dictators, more vehicles, and more chaos in the full game.

And it's cheap af too.

#gamedev #indiegame #games #coop
